items.heading: Peri-Peri Chicken
details: Key ingredients: chicken, peri-peri chili, garlic, lemon
Blend peri-peri chilies with garlic, lemon and oil into a marinade.
Coat chicken pieces thoroughly and marinate for hours.
Grill over hot coals, basting with extra marinade.
Cook until charred outside and juicy inside.

items.heading: Matapa
details: Key ingredients: cassava leaves, peanut paste, coconut milk, shrimp
Pound cassava leaves finely.
Simmer the leaves with coconut milk and peanut paste.
Add shrimp partway through cooking.
Cook until thick and serve over rice.
